arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the histogram

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: histogram_size
arg.description: Number of bins of the histogram of each channel

arg.name: histogram_comparison_type
arg.description: Histogram comparison method. 0: Correlation, 1: Chi-Square, 2: Intersection, 3: Bhattacharyya

arg.name: reference_histogram
arg.description: Reference of the histogram comparison: channels x histogram_size numbers in the layout of ~/histogram, i.e. [b0, b1, ..., g0, g1, ..., r0, r1, ...] for BGR images, [v0, v1, ...] for gray images. Integers and/or decimals, separated by commas and/or spaces (newlines are fine), with or without brackets. Empty to disable the comparison.
